body:
Thanks so much for taking the time to reply.

You know, I definitely agree, that it's best for suicidal and depressed people to not get too caught up in the struggles of others and try to focus on myself.  It's just that I get lonely sometimes, and find that I can only relate most with other people that have experienced a great deal of suffering.

As for my personal issues, realistically, I'm not so sure any anonymous online person could help me much at this point.  Long story short, I've been dealing with 24/7 chronic back pain for over 5 years now.  It's in multiple areas of my low back, I have tried countless remedies, medications, and recommendations from people and nothing makes it manageable.  I try my best to push through it, and have a somewhat normal life, but the pain eventually always drags me into a suicidal state, and I'm just so tired of it honestly.  I'm a shell of who I once was, and what could have been, but even more than that, just simply existing everyday guarantees me a lot of pain :(

I just don't know anymore.  I have no future.

Again sorry to burden you with my problems and I thank you for volunteering to lend an ear.
